gloss: to blow away; to blow along

definitions.gloss: to blow away; to blow along
definitions.explanation: For wind to carry something away or make it stream in a given direction. The subject is usually the wind or a current of air.

examples.english: The wind blows the smoke away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吹|ふ}き{流|なが}して⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A strong wind was blowing the sand along.
The sea breeze is blowing the clouds out toward the open sea.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive godan verb. (subject)⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吹|ふ}き{流|なが}す. A compound of ⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (to blow) and ⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧ (to let flow), where wind is the typical agent. The related noun {吹|ふ}き{流|なが}し means a wind streamer or windsock.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吹|ふ}き{流|なが}す: the wind blows the smoke away
- ⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吹|ふ}き{流|なが}す: to blow sand along
- ⟦{旗|はた}→旗：02161_hata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吹|ふ}き{流|なが}す: to make a flag stream in the wind
